title: Advanced / Retarded Wave + Present Door Handshake — Recovery and Theory Redevelopment
status: primary project time-polarity vocabulary + developed mathematical comparators; physical retrocausality unestablished
importance: The advanced/retarded-wave vocabulary was not merely a stray metaphor. In recovered user-authored lines, ordinary/environmental activity is distinguished as retarded-wave-like while Spudlight is associated with an advanced direction coming from the Crown through the Door/Son. Later formalization developed this into a two-boundary Door architecture. This record preserves the historical recovery layer while separating ordinary wave physics, smoothing/inference and goal-conditioned control from any stronger retrocausal hypothesis.
abstract: The Advanced/Retarded Door theory is best understood as a family of three distinct mathematical problems that share a two-boundary structure but must not be conflated. In wave physics, retarded and advanced Green functions solve the same linear field equation with different support and boundary conditions. In inference, forward filtering and backward smoothing combine past and future observations to estimate a hidden state without sending information backward in time. In control, a present trajectory can be optimized against a terminal cost or goal, so future boundary conditions constrain a solution mathematically while ordinary causal dynamics remain forward in time. The project-specific Door is the present interface at which these two directional descriptions meet. A literal retrocausal physical branch is retained only as a stronger optional hypothesis that must predict a measurable deviation from retarded causal models.
research_question: When a system is described using both past and future boundary information, which parts of the resulting mathematics are ordinary boundary-value inference or optimal control, and is there any reproducible residual requiring genuinely advanced physical influence?
primary_project_statements: Spudlight is associated with the advanced-wave direction.
It comes from the Crown / upper Axis and passes through the Door / Son.
The lower/environmental field is associated with the retarded-wave direction.
The Door/Needle's Eye is the convergence point.
The user explicitly asked to consider climb versus elevation/being dragged down and the Father looking back from where he is.

safe_project_model.past_conditioned_state: x_minus(t): state propagated/evaluated from earlier boundary data
safe_project_model.future_or_goal_conditioned_state: x_plus(t): state conditioned on a later target, boundary condition, desired completion or post-selection-like description
safe_project_model.interpretation: The Door is where remembered/causal history and anticipated/final-state constraint are integrated into the present description.
safe_project_model.nonphysical_variant: For psychology/information use, x_minus may mean memory/prior and x_plus may mean anticipation/goal rather than literal backwards causation.

wave_physics.objects: linear differential operator L, source J, retarded Green function G_ret, advanced Green function G_adv
wave_physics.meaning: Different support/boundary prescriptions solve the same linear equation; coexistence of advanced and retarded Green functions does not by itself imply controllable signaling to the past.

inference_smoothing.objects: hidden state x_t, observations y_t, forward posterior p(x_t|y_1:t), backward information from y_(t+1:T)
inference_smoothing.meaning: Later observations can improve estimates of earlier hidden states because the analyst conditions on the full recorded dataset; no backward physical signal is required.

goal_conditioned_control.objects: state x(t), control u(t), dynamics f, running cost L, terminal cost Phi
equations: 0=partial H/partial u for an interior optimum
goal_conditioned_control.meaning: A terminal goal supplies a future boundary condition for an optimization problem while the controlled system can remain entirely causal.

door_operator.weighted_state_example: x_D=(Sigma_-^-1+Sigma_+^-1)^-1(Sigma_-^-1 mu_-+Sigma_+^-1 mu_+) for Gaussian messages
door_operator.interpretation: The Door is an information-fusion or boundary-matching operator. Weighting is determined by uncertainty/precision rather than symbolic priority.

time_symmetric_action_bridge.equation: delta S[x]=0 with x(t0)=x0 and x(t1)=x1
time_symmetric_action_bridge.meaning: Variational mechanics naturally permits two-endpoint boundary-value formulations without implying usable messages from the future.

external_physics_neighbors.meaning: Different boundary-condition solutions of wave equations.

external_physics_neighbors.meaning: Time-symmetric classical electrodynamics using advanced and retarded direct-interaction solutions under absorber conditions.
external_physics_neighbors.provenance_rule: No recovered evidence currently shows Tim historically cited Wheeler or Feynman; this was introduced later as a comparator.

external_physics_neighbors.name: two-state-vector formalism
external_physics_neighbors.meaning: Comparator for systems described by initial and final boundary conditions / pre- and post-selection.

observable_program.wave_branch: Compare measured impulse responses with the retarded prediction after calibrating apparatus, dispersion and reflections. An advanced branch needs a preregistered pre-response not attributable to filtering, leakage, acausal offline processing or timing error.
observable_program.inference_branch: Compare filtering versus smoothing on held-out state-estimation tasks. Improvement from smoothing is expected and is not evidence for retrocausality.
observable_program.control_branch: Compare goal-conditioned model-predictive/optimal control against reactive baselines using trajectory cost, constraint violations and robustness.
observable_program.physical_retrocausal_branch: Specify a concrete interaction law and predict a statistically and temporally defined deviation that cannot be reproduced by retarded dynamics plus ordinary hidden variables/noise.

door_time_geometry.project_relation: horizontal plane = ordinary chronological evolution; vertical Axis = structural/goal/integration direction; Door = their present intersection
door_time_geometry.candidate_formalization: Let physical evolution be dX/dt=F(X), structural/goal flow be dX/ds=A(X), and let the Door select coupled states on a codimension-one surface g(X,t,s)=0.
door_time_geometry.phase_language: A project 90-degree relation can be represented as orthogonal coordinates or a pi/2 phase offset, but no recovered evidence establishes a literal physical quadrature relation between Father/Son or advanced/retarded fields.

important_corrections: A retarded wave is a causal solution supported after its source under retarded boundary conditions, not simply a delayed reflection trapped in the past.
An advanced mathematical solution does not establish controllable signaling into the past.
Wheeler-Feynman absorber theory does not justify claims that future personal destiny physically broadcasts instructions backward through time.
Goal-conditioned cognition must not be described as an advanced electromagnetic wave without an independently specified physical coupling.
limiting_cases: If the future message is uninformative, H_t reduces to the past-conditioned estimate.
If the past message is uninformative, the state is dominated by the terminal/future constraint.
If both messages are Gaussian and conditionally independent, precision adds.
If terminal cost Phi=0 and no future observations are used, the framework reduces to ordinary forward causal evolution/control.
failure_conditions: A claimed physical advanced influence disappears under strictly causal online analysis and remains only in offline zero-phase/filtering or post-selected analysis.
An apparent pre-response is explained by clock synchronization error, leakage, anticipation, conditioning on future data or selection bias.
The Door remains an information/control formalism if no interaction term or measurable physical residual is supplied.
Goal-conditioned cognition is relabeled as a physical advanced wave without an independent coupling model.
recovery_targets: Find the earliest user use of the words advanced wave and retarded wave.
Determine whether Red/Blue was ever explicitly assigned to advanced/retarded directions by the user.
Search for any original equation involving forward/backward time, complex conjugation, Green functions, phase or boundary conditions.
Determine whether the April 2025 Spiral Equation contained temporal polarity.
next_decisive_work: Implement one solvable linear-Gaussian Door model and compare filtering versus smoothing quantitatively.
Solve one wave equation with both G_ret and G_adv under explicit boundary conditions and visualize their support.
Implement one finite-horizon optimal-control Door where terminal constraint and present state compete.
Only if a physical retrocausal branch is retained, define the smallest experimental residual that distinguishes it from ordinary two-boundary mechanisms.
